source: WebSearch: MDPI Jan 2026 + LightGBM DART research
title: LightGBM DART Mode + Bookmaker Odds Feature

finding_1.description: Replace standard LightGBM GBDT with DART (Dropouts Meet Multiple Additive Regression Trees). DART applies dropout to tree ensembles, reducing over-specialization of later trees. Improves both probability calibration and generalization — directly reduces Brier score. Single parameter change: boosting_type='dart', drop_rate=0.1.
finding_1.implementation: In features/engine.py or hf-space/app.py, add 'lightgbm_dart' to CPU_MODEL_TYPES. Model builder: lgbm.LGBMClassifier(boosting_type='dart', drop_rate=0.1, n_estimators=300). Note: DART is incompatible with early_stopping_rounds — use fixed n_estimators tuned via CV.
finding_1.target_island: S13 (catboost specialist — swap catboost for lightgbm_dart as test)
finding_1.caveat: Slower training (~1.5x) — acceptable for CPU islands

finding_2.description: MDPI 2026 paper achieved Brier 0.199 with logistic regression partly by including market odds (spread, totals, overround) as raw features — not just for post-hoc calibration. The market aggregates huge amounts of information; treating it as a feature directly improves calibration. We already have historical odds data in data/historical-odds/.
finding_2.implementation: Add to features/engine.py Category 47: market_odds. Features: home_line, total, overround, home_implied_prob, away_implied_prob, home_implied_prob_vig_free, market_consensus_spread. Add to feature pool as mandatory minimum (always include when available).

finding_3.description: MDPI Jan 2026 paper used PCA-20 shot-location embeddings derived from shot-chart spatial data. Full model with shot embeddings achieved Brier 0.199. Ablation confirmed shot embeddings are essential — removing them degraded calibration. We already have Cat42 Shot Quality; this extends it with spatial PCA.
finding_3.implementation: Add PCA(n_components=20) on shot-location (x,y) distributions per team in the feature engine. Requires shot-by-shot data from NBA API. Already partially covered by Cat42 Shot Quality — extend with spatial binning + PCA.
finding_3.target_islands: S15 (wide search, pop=50) as test island

immediate_action.step_1: Add 'lightgbm_dart' to CPU_MODEL_TYPES in S14/S13 app.py
